skill_name: Given some inputs, devise a strategy to build trust between a company and its customers.
workflow: Companies should focus on building trust with their customers by being transparent, respecting their customers, and providing high quality service. Transparency should include being open and honest about all policies, procedures, products, services, and customer feedback. Companies should listen to customers' needs and respond in a timely manner whenever possible. They should also demonstrate respect to customers by treating them with fairness, courtesy, and efficiency while they are interacting
